episode.title: Tiny Caterpillar, Spectacular Monarch

shots.scene: Photorealistic nature macro photography, vertical 9:16. One small monarch caterpillar with recognizable black, white and yellow bands rests beneath the leaf junction of a single milkweed stem. Fixed side-on camera angle, soft natural daylight, blurred green meadow background. Frame includes open spa
shots.action: Show the small caterpillar gripping the underside of the leaf junction, its entire body clearly visible.

shots.scene: Photorealistic nature macro photography, vertical 9:16. The same monarch caterpillar beneath the same milkweed leaf junction, identical side-on camera angle, framing, soft daylight and blurred green meadow background. No other animals, people, text, letters or logos.
shots.action: Make the caterpillar larger while preserving its striped markings and its position beneath the leaf junction.

shots.scene: Photorealistic nature macro photography, vertical 9:16. The same monarch caterpillar beneath the same milkweed leaf junction, identical side-on camera angle, framing, soft daylight and blurred green meadow background. No other animals, people, text, letters or logos.
shots.action: Show the caterpillar fully grown and plump, still gripping the same spot in the same orientation.

shots.scene: Photorealistic nature macro photography, vertical 9:16. The same mature monarch caterpillar at the same milkweed leaf junction, identical side-on camera angle, framing, soft daylight and blurred green meadow background. No other animals, people, text, letters or logos.
shots.action: Change its posture into the characteristic hanging J shape, attached by its rear end to a tiny silk pad beneath the junction.

shots.scene: Photorealistic nature macro photography, vertical 9:16. The same monarch now forms a chrysalis suspended beneath the same milkweed leaf junction. Identical side-on camera angle, framing, soft daylight and blurred green meadow background. No other animals, people, text, letters or logos.
shots.action: Replace the hanging caterpillar form with a smooth jade-green monarch chrysalis bearing delicate natural gold accents, attached at the same point.

shots.scene: Photorealistic nature macro photography, vertical 9:16. The same monarch chrysalis suspended beneath the same milkweed leaf junction, identical side-on camera angle, framing, soft daylight and blurred green meadow background. No other animals, people, text, letters or logos.
shots.action: Make the chrysalis casing translucent and darker, revealing the orange-and-black wing pattern inside without changing its shape or attachment.

shots.scene: Photorealistic nature macro photography, vertical 9:16. The same monarch emerging at the same milkweed leaf junction, identical side-on camera angle, framing, soft daylight and blurred green meadow background. No other animals, people, text, letters or logos.
shots.action: Show the newly emerged butterfly gripping its empty chrysalis, with small, soft, crumpled wings hanging downward.

shots.scene: Photorealistic nature macro photography, vertical 9:16. The same monarch butterfly gripping its empty chrysalis beneath the same milkweed leaf junction, identical side-on camera angle, framing, soft daylight and blurred green meadow background. No other animals, people, text, letters or logos.
shots.action: Show its wings fully expanded and held together upright, displaying a magnificent orange side profile with crisp black veins and white-spotted borders.

episode.description: Watch one monarch caterpillar transform into a butterfly, one beautiful stage at a time. Flash cuts reveal nature’s remarkable glow up. #NatureGlowUp #MonarchButterfly #Metamorphosis #MacroNature #NatureReels
